fields.Name: Input
fields.Description: Root of the feature-source space: components that produce a column of the feature matrix.
fields.Story: Inputs are where the business enters the mathematics: each one is a claim that some slice of the data carries signal.

fields.Name: Column
fields.Description: A raw entity column carried into the matrix.
fields.Story: The plainest input: the field as it sits on the record.

fields.Name: Embedding
fields.Description: A persisted, version-pinned embedding expanded to one column per dimension.
fields.Story: Meaning as geometry: text or records mapped into a space where similarity is distance.

fields.Name: LLM-Derived
fields.Description: Features persisted by an upstream Feature Pipeline (LLM-synthesized, version-pinned).
fields.Story: A judgment an LLM already wrote down, frozen so training and scoring read the same answer.

fields.Name: Flow Agent
fields.Description: Per-record MJ Flow Agent invocation mapped into feature columns.
fields.Story: A little procedure runs for every record and its verdict becomes a feature.

fields.Name: Vision LLM
fields.Description: Per-row stateless vision-prompt extraction (category or scalar) from an image column.
fields.Story: Looks at the picture on the record and writes down the one fact the model needs from it.

fields.Name: Code Feature
fields.Description: Any Approved MJ Action satisfying the feature contract (record id + as-of → value); MJ: Actions.CodeApprovalStatus='Approved' is enforced at assembly, before any call. Ported from Sonar.
fields.Story: The escape hatch with a lock on it: arbitrary code can be a feature, but only after a human approved what it does.

fields.Name: As-Of Aggregate
fields.Description: Time-windowed aggregates over dated related rows, computed as of the decision date (leakage-safe). Windows: Rolling, Calendar, SinceEvent, RenewalRelative, AllTime. Ported from Sonar.
fields.Story: These inputs answer "what had already happened by then?" — counting only evidence that existed at the decision moment, which is the discipline that keeps a model honest about the future.

fields.Name: As-Of Sum
fields.Description: Sum of a value field in the window.
fields.Story: How much it added up to.

fields.Name: As-Of Average
fields.Description: Mean of a value field in the window.
fields.Story: What a typical one looked like.

fields.Name: As-Of Minimum
fields.Description: Min of a value field in the window.

fields.Name: As-Of Maximum
fields.Description: Max of a value field in the window.

fields.Name: As-Of Distinct Count
fields.Description: Distinct values of a field in the window.
fields.Story: How varied the activity was — breadth of engagement, not just volume.

fields.Name: As-Of Recency
fields.Description: Days between the last event and the as-of date.
fields.Story: How long the silence has lasted.

fields.Name: As-Of Exists
fields.Description: 1 when any row is in the window.

fields.Name: As-Of Rate Per Period
fields.Description: Count divided by window length in periods.

fields.Name: As-Of Trend Slope
fields.Description: OLS slope of per-period counts across the window.

fields.Name: Forecast
fields.Description: A time-series foundation model (TimesFM) used as a feature extractor: the record's own history, bucketed and cut at the as-of date, becomes a forecast band — p50/p10/p90 at the horizon plus the slope from the last observed value. Zero-shot, so nothing is fitted; the model is CALLED, which is why it is an MJ: AI Models capability and not an algorithm row.
fields.Story: Where this is heading, with an honest range around it. A trend line says one number; this says a band, learned from a billion time points rather than fitted to the last few. It refuses series shorter than the model's 32-step input patch, because below that it would still answer confidently and the answer would be noise.
